contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS AVG ; R/ GLOR[IA] EX[ERC]ITVS

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus of Constantine I dating AD335-341. Reece period 17. Reverse: Two soldiers, one standard. Obverse: Diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS AVG. Reverse: Two soldiers stood either side of one standard. Reverse inscription: GLOR[IA] EX[ERC]ITVS. Mint mark: Illegible. Die axis measurement: 6.00. Dimensions: diameter: 16.93mm; weight: 0.91g
